summary: A static portfolio website for a designer. The home page lists projects ordered newest year first, and each project has its own page showing the project name, year, client, role, and a link to the live project.
targetUsers: Visitors and prospective clients browsing the designer's work
goals: Present all projects on the home page ordered newest year first
Give each project a dedicated page with name, year, client, role, and live project link
nonGoals: Editing or managing project content from the website
Contact forms, comments, or other interactive features

features.name: Project list home page
features.userOutcome: A visitor sees every project listed on the home page, newest year first.
features.trigger: A visitor opens the site's home page.
features.behavior: The home page lists all projects ordered by year descending, so the newest year appears first. Each list entry shows the project name and year and links to that project's page.
features.failureOutcome: The build fails when a project content file is missing a required value such as the project name or year.
acceptanceSignals: The built home page contains one list entry per project content file.
The list entries appear in descending order of project year.
Each list entry links to the corresponding project page.

features.name: Project detail page
features.userOutcome: A visitor reads a single project's name, year, client, role, and follows the link to the live project.
features.trigger: A visitor opens a project's page from the home page list.
features.behavior: Each project has its own page showing the project name, the year, the client, the role, and a link to the live project. The link points to the live project address stored for that project.
features.failureOutcome: The build fails when a project content file is missing a required value such as the client, role, or live project link.
acceptanceSignals: The built project page shows the project name, year, client, and role from its content file.
The built project page contains a link whose target is the stored live project address.
An address that matches no project page shows the site's 404 page.

dataObjects.name: Projects
dataObjects.purpose: The designer's portfolio projects, each with the values shown on its page.
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Kept as site content for as long as the project is part of the portfolio.

qualityRequirements: The home page list is ordered by project year descending with no manual ordering step.
Every project page is reachable from the home page list.
productConstraints: The site is static: pages are built once from project content files.
Project content is supplied by the designer; the site does not invent project names, clients, roles, years, or links.
